summary: Build practical AI skills for HR, recruitment, and talent analytics. Learn through hands-on labs, dashboards, and governance templates.
lede: AI in human resources and talent management applies generative AI, analytics, and automation to talent workflows. Designed for HR professionals and managers, this course addresses recruitment, workforce planning, and employee development through practical work such as drafting job descriptions and interview materials, analyzing skills gaps and talent dashboards, and designing responsible AI workflows with human review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for HR professionals who need to use AI responsibly across talent workflows, workforce planning, and employee development. It also fits managers who oversee HR delivery and need practical outputs they can use immediately.
audience: Compensation and Benefits Analyst using data
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of human resources or talent management processes, including recruitment, onboarding, learning and development, performance management, or workforce planning. No coding is required, but familiarity with HR systems, spreadsheets, and basic data interpretation will help you get more value from the hands-on exercises. The course is best suited to intermediate practitioners who can relate the concepts to live HR workflows and current organizational priorities.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
